skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basics of marketing to organizational customers and the content of the organizational customer market
Analyze and understand the behavior of organizational customers
Identify and segment markets, and determine target markets
Propose marketing strategies and solutions for building plans in the organizational customer market
Understand the decision-making process and buying behavior of organizational customers
Apply marketing communication strategies in organizational markets
Apply general skills (communication, presentation, negotiation) and marketing skills in sales management
Work independently and in teams to build and implement decisions in marketing management
Conduct market research and analyze data to support marketing decisions
Manage products and services in organizational markets
Develop pricing strategies for organizational markets
Develop distribution strategies for organizational markets
